title: Translations
description: Override user-interface texts of the apps without a new release.
note: Overrides replace texts shipped in the apps for the given namespace and key. A key that the app does not use has no effect. Deleting an override restores the built-in text.
deleteBody: {{key}} ({{locale}}) will fall back to the text built into the app.

fields.keyHint: Letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore, e.g. hero.title

validation.oneValue: Enter the text in at least one language
